import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query to find the station with the highest PM10 concentration at the specified time
query_highest_pm10 = text("""
SELECT station_id, pm10
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
ORDER BY pm10 DESC
LIMIT 1
""")

# Execute the query and get the station ID and PM10 value
highest_pm10_station = pd.read_sql(query_highest_pm10, engine)
station_id = highest_pm10_station['station_id'].values[0]
pm10_value = highest_pm10_station['pm10'].values[0]

# Query to find the coordinates of the station with the highest PM10
query_station_coords = text(f"""
SELECT coordinate
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = {station_id}
""")

# Execute the query and get the coordinates
station_coords = pd.read_sql(query_station_coords, engine)
station_coords = station_coords['coordinate'].values[0]

# Query to find the average traffic speed within 500 meters of the station at the specified time
query_avg_speed = text(f"""
SELECT AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrt
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrt.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE hrt.datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
AND ST_DWithin(rs.geometry::geography, {station_coords}::geography, 500)
""")

# Execute the query and get the average speed
avg_speed = pd.read_sql(query_avg_speed, engine)
avg_speed_value = round(avg_speed['avg_speed'].values[0], 1)

# Store the result
avg_speed_near_pm10 = avg_speed_value
print(f"Station ID with highest PM10: {station_id}")
print(f"Highest PM10 concentration: {pm10_value} μg/m³")
print(f"Average traffic speed within 500m: {avg_speed_value} km/h")

# Query to find the coordinates of the station with the highest PM10
query_station_coords = text(f"""
SELECT ST_AsText(coordinate) AS coordinate_wkt
FROM air_quality_station

""")

# Execute the query and get the coordinates in WKT format
station_coords_wkt = pd.read_sql(query_station_coords, engine)
station_coords_wkt = station_coords_wkt['coordinate_wkt'].values[0]

# Query to find the average traffic speed within 500 meters of the station at the specified time

SELECT AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrt
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrt.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE hrt.datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
AND ST_DWithin(rs.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('{station_coords_wkt}', 4326)::geography, 500)
""")
